Make room for teamwork

From feeding the cat to an evening tidy-up, shared responsibilities work best when everyone knows their next small step. TidyTroupe is being built to make that step clear.

Their tasks. Your guidance.

A focused child experience and a protected adult area put family decisions in adults’ hands. Encouragement comes from effort and shared progress, without public rankings.

03

Designed for life at home

The core experience is designed around local device storage, nicknames and no required account. Voice assistance is optional and depends on available device services.
